links.outcome: Clinician-perceived overreliance and reduced critical review of AI results in cancer care
links.effect: Interviewees perceived overreliance on AI and reduced critical review of AI results as negative impacts associated with AI tool use; no numbers reported.
links.quote: Additionally, negative impacts, such as overreliance on AI and reduced critical review of AI results, arise in association with the use of AI tools.

screen.reason: Qualitative interview study evaluating healthcare professionals' perceptions, acceptance, workflow impacts, and concerns (e.g., automation bias) regarding AI tools deployed in oncology clinical practice.
